translation.name: Rio de Janeiro
translation.summary: Spend three to seven days discovering Rio de Janeiro, or make it the first part of a longer journey through Brazil: Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain, the historic centre, beaches, Santa Teresa, Lapa and time to explore at your own pace.

featureBands.title: Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountain
featureBands.text: Corcovado and Sugarloaf offer two different perspectives on the city, its bays, mountains and ocean. Combine them with the historic centre, beaches and Santa Teresa.

featureBands.title: Lapa and Rio's cultural life
featureBands.text: After daytime excursions, spend the evening in Lapa with samba or forró, enjoy a concert or simply unwind by the ocean.

translation.body:
Ada Tours organises journeys to Rio de Janeiro, from a short introduction to the city to a complete tailor-made tour. Your programme can include accommodation, airport welcome, a private or group guide, transfers, tickets, a boat trip, a helicopter experience and extra days in other parts of Brazil.

Carnival and New Year require separate planning. For Carnival, Ada Tours can arrange accommodation, transfers, excursions and Sambadrome tickets. A New Year programme can be built around the celebrations on Copacabana Beach. VIP programmes may include private transfers, individual excursions, suitable accommodation and ticket categories, restaurants and additional services on request.

With a few extra days after Rio, continue to Iguaçu Falls, the Amazon or the Pantanal, or finish your journey with time at the ocean.
